signature.name: VTask.ofEq
signature.type: {ι : Type u_1} -> {V : Type u} -> [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} V] -> [CategoryTheory.Preadditive V] -> {c : ComplexShape ι} -> {C D : HomologicalComplex V c} -> {f g : C ⟶ D} -> (h : f = g) -> Homotopy f g

conventions.statement: The auxiliary chain-homotopy data (the degree-shifting maps) is defined to be the zero morphism in every degree.
conventions.note: This is the canonical trivial choice when f = g and no non-trivial homotopy evidence is required.

facts.statement: ∀ {ι : Type} {V : Type} [CategoryTheory.Category V] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive V] {c : ComplexShape ι} {C D : HomologicalComplex V c} {f : C ⟶ D}, VTask.ofEq (rfl : f = f) ∈ Set.univ

facts.statement: ∀ {ι : Type} {V : Type} [CategoryTheory.Category V] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive V] {c : ComplexShape ι} {C D : HomologicalComplex V c} {f g : C ⟶ D} (h : f = g), h ▸ (VTask.ofEq (rfl : f = f)) = VTask.ofEq h
